title: MRKT pt. 2 - Honestly my fault for posting an HTML file and expecting a positive response lol
author: _gay_dicks420
selftext:
We have built (and are actively improving) a trading terminal with access to institutional grade live market data (CME, LSEG, Reuters) but the key notion is that we don't just leave you alone with this data but we actually contextualize everything for you and whatever asset you are lookin at (FX, stocks, indexes, commodities, crypto). 

The way we do that is by having our AI powered MRKT engine (built brick by brick in a tedious and months long process by traders with 10+ years live experience) scan, pick, weigh and contextualize every single piece of data that hits the market. 

This includes live headlines, of which there are thousands every single day, economic data releases, bonds, cb speaker statements, geopolitical events, a dedicated trump tracker, and lastly price action. 

It gets processed, the engine comes up with a bias (bearish, bearish ranging, neutral, bullish ranging, bullish) created pullback levels based on market structure, provides possible target levels and lets you know exactly why price is current moving the way it is and also, what you fundamental factors are bubbling in the background that could invalidate this bias. 

The idea is to always give you what you need to attack and defend. 

We have a bunch of cool features on top of that like our economic calendar which doesn't only show you the forecast for a release, it actually gives you the range of expectations of banks and institutions (also data not publicly available). We pair this with our economic playbooks that provide you with all possible scenarios of how high impact data releases will impact the asset of your choice. 

There is a bunch more to talk about, please let me know any questions you might have.
